title: FIS Tree
text: Evaluate fuzzy inference system tree, 1 input, 1 output, {Data type} sets Signal data type; {FIS tree name} sets the fIS tree to evaluate, {Number of samples for output discretization} sets the number of points in output fuzzy sets, {Simulate using} sets the simulation mode Interpreted, {Out of range input value} sets the diagnostic message behavior when an input is out of range, {No rule fired} sets the diagnostic message behavior when no rules fire and {Empty output fuzzy set} sets the diagnostic message behavior when an output fuzzy set is empty. Values come from the instance.

params.name: FIS tree name
params.values: FIS tree to evaluate fistree object | MAT file name in quotes

params.name: Number of samples for output discretization
params.values: Number of points in output fuzzy sets 101 (default) | integer greater than 1

params.name: Data type
params.values: Signal data type double (default) | single | fixed-point | expression

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Simulation mode Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation

params.name: Out of range input value
params.values: Diagnostic message behavior when an input is out of range warning (default) | error | none

params.name: No rule fired
params.values: Diagnostic message behavior when no rules fire warning (default) | error | none

params.name: Empty output fuzzy set
params.values: Diagnostic message behavior when an output fuzzy set is empty warning (default) | error | none
